title: Andy Reid on Justin Fields: A legitimate backup who can win games for us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Andy Reid on Justin Fields: A legitimate backup who can win games for us
sources.description: Patrick Mahomes posted an encouraging video about where things stand in his recovery from a torn ACL, but the Chiefs aren't getting ahead of themselves when it comes to planning to have the quarterback ready for the start of the regular season.
